Description.Name: Life-Support Units
Description.Details: Life-Support Units allow for the transportation of critically injured patients, although they require the use of a vehicle to be portable. Frequently used by medevac teams, these units can supply blood, oxygen, and medicines to a patient and deliver both cardiac and neural shocks to keep a patient alive. They are frequently used in conjunction with Portable Medical Monitors.

AssignedCastDescription: Generally, such equipment is intended for medevac teams, but it will be very useful for the M.A.S.H. on our Leopard: it will be much easier to bring seriously wounded MechWarriors on board, and in a much more stable state.
